The biggest cost of Trump's Canada tariffs isn't dairy.

It's trust.

Once businesses stop believing trade agreements will last, investment slows—and that's a much bigger economic problem than one tariff.

More in this week's The Professor Is In: newsletter.platypuseconomics.com/p/should-can...

In the past year, over 4 million Americans have lost food assistance worth about $6 a day.
